mission: Narrow SNKR/Yuyu component continuity to the collectors' Git-derived import graph, fail-closed; tooling/CI only, no collector rollout

impacts.reason: Verification tooling and CI only. New scripts/collector_runtime_inputs.py computes the services/api modules each collector imports (union at installed component and head); SNKR and Yuyu component checks fail on any change to those, to package data, packaging/requirements, the collector directory, its Dockerfile or the identity package, and fall back to the previous whole-directory set when the graph cannot be computed. ci.yml adds three unittest steps to agent-state-tests. No services/, packages/ or deploy/ change: no Railway build, collector rollout, DDL, provider variable, cron, budget, pacing, claim or writer change.

resources: CI agent-state-tests job (3 added unittest steps)
dependencies: local Git objects only; no new Python dependency
impact.deployment_impact: None. No services/, packages/ or deploy/ change: Railway watch patterns (read 2026-10-09T14:4xZ) skip API, worker, beat, market-index and every collector. No collector rollout requested. Images, schedules, budgets, pacing, claims and writers unchanged.

recovery.procedure: Open a PR reverting this merge (restores the whole-directory SNKR_PATHS/Yuyu git diff). Tooling-only; no Railway or database action.
recovery.trigger: Any evidence that a collector-executed module changed without failing continuity, or any CI/delivery verifier failure attributable to this change.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no persistent state, schema, variable or deployment changes.

verification.observation_window: The staging delivery of this merge: every Railway service SKIPPED, API expectation skip, both component checks PASS with basis 'unchanged' on 1b1b64d, and the next natural collector receipts still report the activation deployments.
